<!-- Code generated by xgen. DO NOT EDIT. -->

<!--
  A heading and the names of customers or partners as Lucide glyphs with a name. Axes: layout (grid, row),
  columns (2, 3, 4), item (name, icon only, tile), density, tone.
-->
<script lang="ts" module>
  import type { Snippet } from "svelte";
  import type { Logo } from "./logo-cloud.types";

  export type LogoCloudProps = {
    id: string;
    title: string;
    logos: Logo[];
    layout?: "grid" | "row";
    cols?: "2" | "3" | "4";
    item?: "name" | "icon" | "tile";
    tone?: "default" | "muted";
    density?: "roomy" | "default" | "compact";
    landmarkLabel?: string;
  };
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import Grid from "../primitives/grid/grid.svelte";
  import Group from "../primitives/group/group.svelte";
  import LucideIcon from "../primitives/lucide-icon/lucide-icon.svelte";
  import Text from "../primitives/text/text.svelte";
  import LogoRibbon from "../blocks/logo-ribbon.svelte";
  import SectionFrame from "../components/section-frame.svelte";
  import { cn } from "../utils";

  let {
    id,
    title,
    logos,
    layout = "grid",
    cols = "4",
    item = "name",
    tone = "default",
    density = "default",
    landmarkLabel,
  }: LogoCloudProps = $props();
</script>

{#if ((layout as string) === "row")}
  <LogoRibbon id={id} title={title} logos={logos} tone={tone} density={density} landmarkLabel={landmarkLabel} />
{:else}
  <SectionFrame id={id} title={title} tone={tone} density={density} align="center" landmarkLabel={landmarkLabel}>
    <Grid
      cols={
        (cols as string) === "2" ? "2"
        : (cols as string) === "3" ? "2-3"
        : (cols as string) === "4" ? "2-4"
        : "3-6"
      }
      class="gap-4"
      data-testid="items"
    >
      {#each logos as logo (logo.id)}
        <Group
          gap="2"
          align="center"
          justify="center"
          class={cn(
            "text-muted-foreground",
            (((item as string) === "tile") ? "flex-col rounded p-4 inset-ring inset-ring-border" : "")
          )}
          data-testid="item"
        >
          <LucideIcon name={logo.icon} size={24} />
          <Text size="sm" weight="semibold" class={(((item as string) === "icon") ? "sr-only" : "")}>
            {logo.name}
          </Text>
        </Group>
      {/each}
    </Grid>
  </SectionFrame>
{/if}
